findings.title: This call does not match the inherited method signature
findings.body: `UsernamePasswordForm` defines `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel)`, and no zero-argument overload exists in its superclass. This invocation therefore fails Java compilation; pass the current user or add the intended overload.

findings.title: Conditional passkeys are disabled before a user is identified
findings.body: This helper returns false whenever `user` is null, but the initial login is precisely when a userless discoverable passkey must be offered. The calls that populate the form with WebAuthn challenge data are guarded by this helper, so normal unauthenticated logins through this form no longer get conditional passkey UI; passkey-only users cannot authenticate through this flow.

findings.title: Clear setup events before asserting the first login
findings.body: This test logs out after `registerDefaultUser()` but does not clear captured events before opening the login form. Setup can leave login events in the event collector, so the following `expectLogin()` may inspect a stale event instead of the passkey login. Clear the events after logout, as the neighboring tests do.
